content.article: A newcomer's first deposit at Longfu88 can earn a 188% Casino Welcome Bonus, with €2,088 as its limit and 18 Free Spins on top. Staking requirements: 25x on deposit plus bonus together, 40x on the winnings from Free Spins. This Longfu bonus overview for Longfu88 continues with reloads, VIP-level cashback, the VIP program and the rewards area. Readers in Singapore are addressed here, and every promotion at Longfu88 is restricted to players who have reached the age of 18.

The Welcome Offer as an Entry Point

New registered players start with the Longfu88 welcome bonus, which appears in the casino as the Casino Welcome Bonus. Matching of the first qualifying deposit stands at 188%, with €2,088 as the top amount, and the package includes 18 Free Spins. Opening the offer takes a first deposit of €50. Each account is entitled to a single welcome offer at Longfu88.

Longfu88 lists two alternatives next to it. One, named Live Casino Welcome Bonus, targets live casino fans, with 125% up to €888 and a ceiling that is lower than that of the main offer. In USDT, the Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus keeps the 188% of the main offer and tops out at 2,888 USDT. Choosing the standard casino offer rules out the crypto version and vice versa, so one of them covers the first deposit. The conditions of the main offer are covered in the terms section below.

Claim It in Three Sentences

Registration comes first at Longfu88. A player creates an account, enters the personal data requested and then makes a first qualifying deposit. Before betting starts, the player has to complete the activation in My Bonuses of the Casino Welcome Bonus. Once that is done, the required wagering has to be completed on eligible casino games during the validity of the offer, a period of 10 days that starts at activation. The countdown therefore begins on activation and not on the deposit.

Terms in Short

Wagering for the Casino Welcome Bonus comes in two parts, meaning two amounts a player has to stake before bonus funds can leave the account. The first, 25x, is measured on the deposit plus the bonus taken as one sum, and the second, 40x, belongs to Free Spins winnings alone. As a result, the spins are cleared separately from the main requirement. Both parts are due inside the 10-day validity that starts at activation, so at Longfu88 the countdown is tied to the activation date and not to the deposit date. The offer also has limits on bets and on withdrawals. Each spin is capped at a €22.5 stake, and the cashout cap stands at 5x of the original bonus sum, which sets the upper limit of what the bonus can turn into a withdrawal.

Longfu88 Promo Code and My Bonuses

No promo code is named anywhere in the offer details at Longfu88. The claim itself is made in the My Bonuses section. For the Casino Welcome Bonus, switching on happens in that section before the first wager, whereas every other offer is switched on only after its eligibility rules and deposit requirements have been fulfilled. A typical sequence is a qualifying deposit followed by a visit to My Bonuses to turn the offer on. For each listed offer, the deposit conditions come ahead of activation.

Reloads for Regular Depositors

Longfu88 lists four reloads for players who deposit again on weekdays or at weekends. Reward, minimum deposit and wagering requirement are set separately for every one. Crypto versions are denominated in USDT and the rest in euros, so each table row stays in its own currency.

Period Reload Reward Wagering requirement Minimum deposit
Weekly Casino Weekly Crypto Reload Capped at 1,000 USDT, at a 60% rate 30 times (deposit + bonus) 20 USDT
Weekend Casino Weekend Reload Capped at €3,360, plus 50 Free Spins 40 times on Free Spins winnings plus 30 times on deposit + bonus €50
Weekend Casino Weekend Crypto Reload Capped at 750 USDT at a 75% rate, plus 100 Free Spins 30 times for deposit + bonus, and 40 times for Free Spins winnings 20 USDT
Single day Casino Double Fortune Capped at €500, at a 50% rate 30 times (deposit + bonus) €30

A 7-day validity covers the weekly and weekend reloads, and the 24-hour Double Fortune offer (One-Day Reload Special) is the shortest of the four. Each spin is limited to €5 while bonus funds are wagered. A casino bonus cannot be activated while another one is running, reloads included.

Free Spins in Short

Wagering on Free Spins is kept apart from wagering on a deposit at Longfu88. Take the Casino Weekly Reload: once at least €30 has been deposited, it hands out 50 Free Spins valid for 7 days, and what they win must be wagered 40x. The welcome bonus spins, 18 in total, follow suit with 40x on their winnings. In both cases the spin winnings stay locked until that requirement has been cleared.

Seasonal Campaigns

Seasonal campaigns rotate, so the current list is kept in the casino's promotions area. Longfu88 carries two of them among its offers. The first is the Pumpkin Bonanza (Casino Trick or Treat edition): a minimum deposit of €20 unlocks up to 100 Free Spins, which are valid for 7 days and whose winnings have 40x wagering. Second comes the Casino Dragon Quest, subtitled Get Verified and Get Extra! Completing the account verification that the campaign asks for earns a player €10 in bonus credit. The campaign also sets €20 as the minimum deposit, with wagering of 30x on the credit, and 7 days of validity. Both limit each spin to €5 during the wagering of bonus funds, and neither can run together with another active casino bonus.

Cashback by VIP Level

Cashback at Longfu88 starts with a weekly offer, the Casino Weekly Cashback. Its rate peaks at 10% of net casino losses for the week, and €6,988 is the cap. Each cashback week is bounded by Monday 00:00 UTC at the start and Sunday 23:59 UTC at the end. €4.5 marks the minimum cashback. A cycle lasts four weeks after opting in, and active accounts may be renewed automatically. Wagering equals 10x the cashback received, so the amount is turned over before withdrawal. Bets with real money at casino games count, while bonus funds do not. The player's VIP level sets the rate, as the table below lists it, and the reward levels themselves are described in the VIP program section.

Each Monday the weekly cashback arrives in My Bonuses at Longfu88, and activation is needed there, because the cashback lapses when its claim window passes without activation. Live Casino Cashback is a different offer: 25%, capped at €850, with wagering of 10x on the credited cashback. Opting in and activation happen in My Bonuses again, crediting is on Mondays as well, and the basis is made of stakes in eligible Live Casino games, taken in real money and net of winnings.

VIP tier Maximum Rate
Bronze €1,888 2%
Silver €2,388 4%

Rebates Credited Daily

Rebates at Longfu88 are a share of the settled real-money bets that qualify, and every rebate belongs to one game category. The four unlimited rebates cover casino games, live casino, P2P and lottery, with their rates in the table.

Rate Rebate Category
0.9% Unlimited Casino Rebate Casino games
1.0% Unlimited Live Casino Rebate Live casino
0.8% Unlimited P2P Rebate P2P
1.0% Unlimited Lottery Rebate Lottery

Each day, the rewards balance receives the credited rebate, which must then be wagered once (1x).

The VIP Program in Depth: Eight of 25 Levels

Tiers of the VIP Program, five in all: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond. VIP points come from real-money gameplay that is eligible, and Longfu88 turns them into a ladder of 25 numbered levels with rewards. A points threshold and a level reward belong to every level. For instance, 30 points mean level 3 and a reward of €14.7, and 300 points reach level 8, which pays €73.5. The table covers eight of the 25 levels, namely 1, 3, 5, 8, 10, 15, 20 and 25, and the reward column shows what each of them pays.

Level Level reward Points required
25 €980 5500

Rewards grow with the level: level 1 pays €9.8 and level 25 pays €980, while the points climb from 1 to 5500 across the same span. Between level 10 at 700 points and level 15 at 2100 points, the reward rises from €147 to €392, and level 20 sits at 3600 points and €637. Levels 1 and 25 mark the lowest and the highest step of the ladder. A personal VIP manager is listed as well, available to the high tiers that are eligible, and the benefits include VIP cashback and personalised offers, while withdrawal limits are higher. Reward amounts and withdrawal limits depend on the level and on the currency, and benefits tied to a level can change under the program rules, so a player who plans around one level checks the current program terms first.

The Rewards Area: Where Each Feature Sits

The rewards area at Longfu88 sits in the Rewards menu and brings game-like features on top of the bonuses, so where a feature is found matters as much as what it does. Coins tie several features together: the Wheel of Fortune takes them for a spin and also lists them as a prize, and the Coin Shop turns earned Coins into rewards. The area has five features, and rewards from Wheel of Fortune as well as from Bonus Crab are valid for 7 days.

  • Bonus Crab: qualifying picks, once claimed, open a crab reward, and the reward is valid for 7 days from assignment.
  • Wheel of Fortune: spinning requires Coins or an eligible spin, and the wheel pays bonus credits, Free Spins or Coins, with 7 days of validity.
  • Challenges: gambling tasks that qualify open up listed rewards, under Rewards > Challenges.
  • Collections: items from campaigns are collected as qualifying activity is completed, under Rewards > Collections.
  • Coin Shop: earned Coins buy reward items and bonus credits, with the credits reaching €4,500, under Rewards > Shop.

A reward can come with its own wagering requirement, so its terms are read alongside it. Bonus Crab, the first in the list, shows what such numbers look like, and the sub-section below walks through it step by step.

How Longfu88 Bonus Crab Works

Qualifying picks are what Bonus Crab runs on. A player claims them to open a crab reward, which reveals a casino prize. Free picks can be earned through activity that qualifies, anywhere in the rewards area. The feature therefore combines two things: picks as the entry and a prize that comes out of the crab reward. Next to the Coin Shop, Challenges, Collections and Wheel of Fortune, it offers three kinds of prize:

  • Bonus credits
  • Free Spins
  • Coins

Those prizes are awarded through Bonus Crab at Longfu88, and a crab reward carries a validity of 7 days from assignment. The wagering depends on the prize: awarded bonus credit has to be wagered 30x, and Free Spins winnings 40x, so two separate multiples apply. Because the kinds of prize differ, the wagering differs as well.

Live Casino Offers for Regulars

Newcomers to live casino games can use the Live Casino Welcome Bonus, which gives 125% on the first qualifying deposit, capped at €888. Its terms are a deposit of €30 at minimum, 30x wagering on deposit and bonus together, a 7-day validity and a bet limit of €25. For repeat play, Longfu88 adds two live offers. A cashback of 25%, capped at €850, is the Live Casino Cashback, wagered 10x on the credited amount, and eligible Live Casino games supply the stakes, counted in real money and net of winnings. The Unlimited Live Casino Rebate credits 1.0% daily.

Sports Bonus Basics for Casino Players

Sportsbook users have their own bonuses, separate from the casino. Take the Sport First Deposit Bonus, offered by Longfu88: it matches 100% of a deposit of at least €50, up to €1,888, comes with 8x wagering on deposit and bonus, and lasts 30 days. Sports betting therefore has bonus terms of its own, kept apart from the casino ones. Settled bets are the only ones counted toward the wagering, provided they qualify, so a bet still open leaves the requirement unchanged. Qualifying odds start at 2.00 for singles, and in an accumulator every selection must have odds of 1.50 at least, so it is worth reading the odds before placing a stake.

Rewards on a Phone

Because the Longfu88 website adapts to the screen, reaching the bonuses discussed here takes nothing more than the browser of a phone or tablet. The mobile website features Bonuses alongside the casino and sportsbook sections, with deposits, withdrawals and account access around them. Switching an offer on takes place in My Bonuses. For more about mobile access, there is the app page.

content.title: Longfu88 Offers: Loyalty and Rewards Questions

faqs.question: What are VIP points for?
faqs.answer: Eligible real-money gameplay earns them, and the levels they open are numbered, each with a points requirement and a level reward.

faqs.question: How does Bonus Crab pay out?
faqs.answer: A player claims qualifying picks, opens a crab reward and sees a casino prize: bonus credits, Free Spins or Coins.

faqs.question: What is sold in the Coin Shop?
faqs.answer: Reward items and bonus credits, paid for with earned Coins, where the bonus credits go up to €4,500. The shop sits under Rewards > Shop in the rewards area.

faqs.question: How high can the weekly cashback go?
faqs.answer: The weekly cashback tops out at 10% of net casino losses, and €6,988 is the cap. Its actual rate depends on the VIP level.

faqs.question: How often are unlimited rebates paid?
faqs.answer: Every day, the rewards balance receives it. A credited rebate comes with 1x wagering, so a new amount can arrive each day and must be wagered once.

faqs.question: How often can a reload be claimed?
faqs.answer: Each promotional period allows one claim, unless the offer states otherwise. For the same reload, the next period has to start first, and only then can it be claimed again.

faqs.question: Where can bonus questions be asked?
faqs.answer: Support at Longfu88 has a live chat that stays open all day, every day (24/7), and takes e-mails too, so a question about bonus terms can go either way.
